prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Columbus Ohio for a car accident case?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objective “best” personal injury lawyer for every car-accident case in Columbus — the right attorney depends on your case facts (severity of injuries, fault/insurance issues, whether liability is disputed), your goals (quick settlement vs trial), and how you want to work with the lawyer. Instead of one name, here’s a quick plan to find the best lawyer for you.

How to choose the best lawyer for your car-accident case
- Look for focused experience: attorneys who handle car-accident and bodily-injury cases regularly (not general practitioners).
- Trial experience: if liability or value is likely to be disputed, prefer a lawyer who actually tries cases in court.
- Results & reputation: look for past settlements/verdicts, peer ratings (Super Lawyers, Martindale‑Hubbell, AVVO), and client reviews.
- Local experience: Columbus lawyers who know local judges, courts, and insurers often perform better.
- Communication style: pick someone who explains things clearly, returns calls, and gives realistic expectations.
- Fee structure: most PI lawyers work on contingency (commonly 33%–40% + expenses). Make sure you understand the contract.
- Accessibility & staffing: who will handle day-to-day communication — the lead lawyer or paralegals?

Where to search and verify credentials
- Columbus Bar Association and Ohio State Bar Association referral services
- Super Lawyers and Super Lawyers “Top Lists”
- Martindale‑Hubbell peer-review ratings
- AVVO and Google Maps for client reviews
- Million Dollar Advocates Forum or National Trial Lawyers (for high-value cases)
- Ohio Supreme Court lawyer disciplinary lookup for any public discipline

Questions to ask in a free consultation
- How many car-accident cases have you handled? How many went to trial?
- Have you handled cases like mine (similar injuries/insurance issues)?
- What outcome should I reasonably expect? What’s a likely timeline?
- What percentage do you charge? Are there additional costs I’ll owe?
- Who in your firm will handle my file day to day?
- Can you provide references or examples of past results?

Immediate next steps you can take
- Gather accident report, photos, medical records, insurance correspondence.
- Contact 3–4 attorneys for free consultations and compare answers.
- Don’t sign anything or accept a settlement offer from the insurer before consulting an attorney.

If you’d like, tell me a few details (where in Columbus the crash was, how serious the injuries, whether fault is disputed, any offer from the insurer), and I can:
- suggest a short list of Columbus firms or attorneys to contact (based on commonly recommended sources), or
- provide tailored interview questions for your situation.
